title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
description:
S01 E09 — Battles
From ancient battles at Cannae and Agincourt, to World War II's Battle of the Bulge and the Battle of Stalingrad; these are history's deadliest conflicts.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
description:
S01 E10 — Criminals
Drug kingpins, serial killers, pirates, assassins, and murderous con men; criminals with bloody legacies.

title: History's Deadliest With Ving Rhames
description:
S01 E08 — Engineering Disasters
Cost-cutting moves to save on some of the Titanic's three million rivets; shortcuts taken while building a gladiator stadium in ancient Rome; how a little carelessness triggers deadly engineering failures in history.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S01 E03 — Chamber of Secrets
From priceless treasure found inside a lost city, to an ancient manuscript hidden behind a wall, explores mysterious secrets lost deep inside various unseen chambers like tunnels, caves and burial sites.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S02 E19 — Strange Finds
Some discoveries defy explanation, like fossilized vomit from the Jurassic era, a sewer blob with a pulse, even a long-lost toy discovered inside a man's lung. These freaky finds prove that reality can be stranger-and far creepier-than fiction.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S01 E05 — Sacred Discoveries
From ancient religious texts buried in Egypt to cultural relics found at sea, or even a tower of skulls hiding under the earth, these lost artifacts change what is known about certain sacred beliefs.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S02 E05 — Famous Finds
A forgotten manuscript in a dusty trunk; a priceless painting discovered in plain sight; a royal tomb hidden for millennia beneath the sands; these famous finds prove history's greatest treasures often resurface when least expected.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S02 E11 — Puzzling Finds
Riddles don't just live in books, they're all around us.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S02 E16 — Powerful Discoveries
From Mussolini's hidden bunker, to a warship built to dominate, and coins bearing Henry VIII's authority, these discoveries reveal how power leaves its mark long after its rulers are gone.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S01 E04 — Military Secrets
From clandestine nuclear weapons programs to a secret Cold War bunker hidden in the mountains, or even World War 2 technology at the bottom of the sea, we explore the unlikely people, and surprising places.

title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
description:
S02 E13 — Heavy Metals
A James Bond submarine car stored in a locker, rock guitars with historical roots and locomotives resting on the ocean floor demonstrate how heavy metal artifacts preserve historical events.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E06 — Bizarre Innovations
A fully functioning car that hovers in midair; clothing made out of calcium; a robot dog that breathes fire; discussing bizarre inventions.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E03 — Fantastic Beings
Exploring the stories of the planet's fantastic beings.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E10 — Wildest Weapons
Weapons rank among humanity's most powerful-and wildest-inventions; some unleash mass destruction, while others are downright bizarre; from launching corpses with trebuchets, to turning animals into killing machines.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E18 — Most Astonishing Creatures
Some of Earth's most remarkable creatures push the limits of belief from a headless chicken who toured the nation, to a goat who tipped the scales of war, to dolphins drafted into Cold War espionage.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E04 — Unusual Places
A city where the commute requires a zipline; a town crawling with monkeys; a waterfall of blood.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E16 — Unlikely Heroes
How did a pet pig spring into action to save its owner's life? Which mysterious spirits became the unlikely heroes that turned the tide for a doomed flight? And what shocking move did a carjacker make to rescue a baby trapped in a scorching car?

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E08 — Strange Experiments
Monkey glands for immortality, hypnotized assassins and a brain-linked cyborg couple; investigating some of the strangest experiments on record.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E12 — Extraordinary Journeys
From a dog's space voyage, to a harrowing story of Arctic survival, to various trips through time; journeys so extraordinary that they are truly unbelievable.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E07 — Strange Games
Toe wrestling; a competition between ugly pets; the origins of some schoolyard face-offs; exploring the world of strange games.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E15 — When Darkness Falls
When the sun sets, strange things come alive; imagine a full-scale war waged against thousands of invading frogs, an artist who only paints while sleepwalking, and battlefield wounds that literally glow in the dark.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E01 — Strange Places
Exploring the Lake Michigan Triangle and many other wild and weird places, including a doll-filled island with a dark past, deadly gas-filled explosive lakes, caves that harbor deadly viruses and a haunted place in the United States.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E19 — Strange Afflictions
A trip to the doctor is sure to cure any afflicted individual, but what happens when even the doctors are stunned by what they see?; from a family cursed with blue skin, to a girl allergic to the world's most unlimited resource and more.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E14 — Out of this World
From a piece of the International Space Station crashing into a Florida home, to the first chimpanzee blasted into space, to a mind-bending time slip experienced by two women in Versailles.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S04 E04 — Astonishing Beings
The world is full of creatures who make you look twice; from a baboon who becomes a reliable employee at a 19th-century train station, to a Moulin Rouge performer who builds a career on controlled flatulence.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S04 E01 — Epic Fails
A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S04 E02 — Peculiar Places
A bleeding house; a near-boiling river; a desert of unexplained encounters; these are peculiar places on Earth.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E10 — The Puzzling Pyramids of Egypt
Awe-inspiring and mysterious, the pyramids of Egypt are significant wonders of the ancient world; more than 4,000 years old, they are celebrated architectural marvels, but no one fully understands how they were built or why.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E07 — The Lost Loot of Jesse James
Cash, jewels, and two million dollars in gold bars; Jesse James and his gang robbed trains, stagecoaches and banks, and buried the spoils; but only a fraction of the millions has actually been found.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E14 — Who Is D.B. Cooper?
It's the only unsolved air piracy case in history; in 1971, a man hijacks a Northwest Orient Airlines flight, demanding four parachutes and $200,000; he jumps out of the plane with the money and is never seen again.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S01 E05 — Roswell: The First Witness -- The Journal
A cryptic journal sparks an unprecedented investigation into whether a UFO crashed at Roswell, N.M., in 1947; Major Jesse Marcel's journal may contain coded clues to the truth behind Roswell.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S01 E06 — Roswell: The First Witness -- The Memo
A former CIA operative's investigation into the Roswell crash arrives at a critical moment when the mysterious journal found among the possessions of Maj. Jesse Marcel undergoes a crucial test.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S01 E07 — Roswell: The First Witness -- The Writer
Investigator Ben Smith travels to Jesse Marcel's hometown on Louisiana's Gulf Coast to speak with family members who reveal information that supports Marcel's story of a government cover-up.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E06 — Serial Killer Creatures
The animal kingdom is full of deadly predators, and some of them attack in extraordinary and inexplicable ways; some animals strike back at humans for reasons beyond normal defense and hunger.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E16 — Real Life Monsters
For centuries, fantastic tales of terrifying monsters have fascinated mankind; bizarre beasts of all shapes and sizes have been portrayed in some of history's most classic stories and folklore.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S05 E02 — Tales of the Dearly Departed
Whether ancient burial practices, like graves, tombs and cremations, can preserve the soul for eternity or bring the dead back to life.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S08 E14 — Deadly Ancient Curses
Throughout history, people have feared that ancient curses can bring misfortune, madness and even death to those who defy them; are these deadly warnings powered by supernatural forces or by the terrifying ability of belief itself to shape reality?

title: The UnXplained
description:
S04 E14 — The Hunt for Jack the Ripper
The question of the identity of Jack the Ripper has baffled police investigators, historians, and armchair detectives for over a century, even with media offering its own unique take on the killer's identity.

title: The UnXplained
description:
S01 E15 — Vampires and Werewolves
Dracula, Lycaon of Arcadia, the Beast of Gévaudan; these are the names of grotesque monsters who have reared their terrifying heads throughout history, unearthly creatures that thrived on human blood and flesh.

title: The UnXplained
description:

Examining mankind's fascination with the dead, from ancient civilizations to 20th-century empires, and the possible reasons for that focus.

description:
S20 E05 — Pick Like a Honey Badger
Mike and Frank are itching to see what is inside a barn that has been off-limits for a quarter of a century; while Mike makes like a honey badger, bundle master Frank strikes again.

title: American Pickers
description:
S18 E05 — Frank's Big Day
Frank jumps for joy as he and Mike pick a recently closed toy museum ready to sell their collection of treasures.

title: American Pickers
description:
S06 E03 — Mike's Holy Grail
The guys get a vague lead on the holy grail of motorbikes; Mike puts pressure on Danielle to track down a XAVW; Betty's sprawling warehouses; Dale's awesome junkyard and a noble cause.

title: American Pickers
description:
S01 E07 — Frank's Gamble
After the guys discover a basement full of vintage cars, Frank makes a big offer for a 1939 Plymouth; the guys find a mother lode of rare bikes and motorbikes in New Hampshire.

title: American Pickers
description:
S04 E03 — Airstream Dream
The guys tap into their spirit animals to track down a lifetime picker; a bizarre totem pole catches Mike's eye; an original Airstream trailer renders Mike speechless.

title: American Pickers
description:
S23 E10 — Wolves in Wisconsin
On Uncle Butch's 10-acre homestead in Wisconsin, the Wolfe brothers pay big money for some rare nuggets of petroliana but strike out on a jaw-dropping ride with a Hollywood pedigree; Mike meets a 97-year-old inventor.

title: American Pickers
description:
S26 E09 — Speedway Thrills
In Arizona, Mike relives the thrill of speedway history, thanks to a motorbike-loving family, that has a garage full of one-of-a-kind racing mementos.

title: American Pickers
description:
S14 E18 — Frank's Birthday
Frank celebrates his birthday; the guys fulfill a woman's dream by making a deal to honor her deceased husband.

title: American Pickers
description:
S20 E07 — Rock 'n' Roll Heaven
It's all rock 'n' roll as the guys tackle the painstaking preservation of Aerosmith's original tour van; star-struck Frank picks one of his teen idols.

title: American Pickers
description:
S24 E18 — Picking the Godfather
The Pacific Northwest is a picking paradise as Mike crashes into the godfather of Italian scooters, while Robbie and Jersey nearly drown in a sea of smalls.

title: American Pickers
description:
S12 E13 — Escape to Motor Mountain
The pickers find a mound of motorcycles, but it's guarded by booby traps; and a stubborn collector gets in the way of the guys and a mega-warehouse mega-pick.

title: American Pickers: Best Of
description:
Tri-State Pickin'
Jersey Jon picks the Tri-State with the help of some friends. From the suburbs of Connecticut to the heart of Manhattan and the sunny seaside shore of New Jersey, will Jon broker some amazing deals or head home empty-handed?

title: American Pickers
description:
S24 E10 — Detroit Dreaming
At Detroit's abandoned Packard plant, Mike gets a tour of an American landmark before it disappears; in Buffalo, Retro Ron's collection features the Holy Grail of vintage bikes.

title: American Pickers
description:
S16 E01 — Tough Nut to Crack
When Frank goes nuts for a century-old snack icon, he must decide if it's worth the high asking price; Mike falls hard for a Roaring '20s roadster.

title: American Pickers
description:

Mike makes deal after deal; Frank hits a snag with a straight-talking Wisconsin collector who won't move on prices.
